checks.description: The official CWI logo is present on every shipped visual asset, including the wristband's clasp in the index.html mockup. Brand rule: the logo ships on everything — the clasp carries the CWI badge and no config removes it.

The shipped band config validates against tally-schema.json (cwi-tally/v1): all required keys present, enums in-vocabulary (material, shape, bezel, unit), hex colors valid, and every counter carries label, value, unit, source, verified flag, and proof_url.
DEFAULT_CONFIG + optional config.json override flow works: a config.json with orgName/productName/colors overrides the CWI defaults and produces a branded build with no unreplaced tokens.
EQUIP / CONFIGURE / APPLY steps are copy-paste operable: every URL referenced (band config, schema, card, page, hub device, contact) is live, and the APPLY block is a valid tally-token snippet.
